categories.main_business_segments: Cousins Properties operates primarily in the office real estate segment, focusing on the development, acquisition, leasing, management, and ownership of Class A office properties and select mixed-use developments. The company’s activities are measured and reported by geographic area, with a strategic focus on Sun Belt markets including Atlanta, Austin, Tampa, Charlotte, Phoenix, Dallas, and Nashville.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core operations involve real estate development, property management, and leasing, with an emphasis on sustainability and operational efficiency. Cousins incorporates industry standards such as LEED, EnergyStar, BOMA 360, and Fitwel in building design and operations, and utilizes local operating platforms to manage properties and execute capital projects. The company also invests in energy conservation, resource efficiency, and healthy building certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Cousins serves a diverse base of office tenants, including major technology, financial, professional services, legal, energy, and healthcare companies. Its largest tenants include Amazon, Alphabet, NCR Voyix, ExxonMobil, and IBM, with significant exposure to technology firms in Austin, financial institutions in Charlotte, and biotech/health science in Tampa. The company’s end markets are primarily large corporate office users seeking high-quality, efficient, and resilient office space in Sun Belt cities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s portfolio is concentrated in the Sun Belt region of the United States, with major operations in Atlanta, Austin, Tampa, Charlotte, Phoenix, Dallas, and Nashville. As of year-end 2024, Atlanta and Austin are the largest contributors to net operating income, followed by Tampa, Charlotte, Phoenix, and Dallas. Cousins also holds land for future development in these markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cousins operates as an owner, developer, and manager at the downstream end of the commercial real estate supply chain, directly interfacing with tenants and end users. The company also participates in joint ventures and occasionally invests in real estate debt, but its primary role is as a landlord and operator of office properties.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategy centers on disciplined capital allocation, maintaining a portfolio of newer, efficient, and resilient office properties in high-growth Sun Belt markets. Strategic priorities include opportunistic acquisitions, selective development, timely disposition of non-core assets, and sustainability initiatives. Cousins emphasizes maintaining a low-leverage balance sheet, strong local operating platforms, and ongoing investment in sustainability, energy efficiency, and healthy building certifications.
categories.revenue_model: Cousins generates revenue primarily through rental income from operating leases, including base rent, tenant reimbursements for operating expenses, and parking revenue. Additional revenue streams include development, management, and leasing fees from joint ventures, as well as interest income from investments in real estate debt. The company also recognizes gains from property and joint venture sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cousins competes with other office property owners, developers, and real estate investment trusts (REITs), as well as financial institutions, pension funds, and private investors. Key competitive factors include property location, building quality, sustainability, amenities, and operational efficiency. The company positions itself as a leading owner of premier office assets in the Sun Belt, with a focus on high-quality, resilient, and sustainable properties.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, Cousins reported total assets of $8.8 billion and net operating income of $563.7 million for the year. The company’s office portfolio comprises over 21 million square feet, with a weighted average occupancy of 89.2% and annualized rent of $843.7 million. Recent growth has been driven by acquisitions in Austin and Charlotte, new development completions, and positive same-property net operating income growth of 4.8% (cash basis) in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cousins emphasizes ownership of high-quality, efficient, and resilient office buildings in dynamic Sun Belt markets, offering tenants modern amenities, sustainability features, and proximity to transit. The company differentiates itself through disciplined capital allocation, a strong balance sheet, local market expertise, and a long-standing commitment to sustainability and healthy building practices, aiming to attract top-tier tenants and deliver long-term value to shareholders.
